decision: Do not promote first-box stopping to GPU; keep RC14 fixed.
interpretation: An easily detected explicit boxed answer is usually too late. Earlier natural-language answers require semantic identification and distinguishing intermediate quantities; not implemented or validated here.
next_boundary: No automatic keyword broadening or threshold sweep on these exposed questions. A substantive prefix-only completion detector needs its own specification and useful-correction counterexamples before GPU authorization.
limitations: Character fractions are descriptive, not token compression estimates or counterfactual accuracy. Conservative answer matching leaves symbolic mismatches unknown.
